scope: Owner-approved Open Threshold logo reference; editable and optimized runtime exports remain pending.
commonPrompt:
Design one original CELAHAN logo-concept presentation, flat vector-like artwork, crisp edges and carefully balanced optical proportions. Brand: web-application security-assessment concept for a university/portfolio website; professional, precise, approachable enough to coexist with small pet mascots. Palette only warm near-black #0C0D0B, ivory #F3F0E8, sand #C9BA8C. Main background almost-black. The supplied website image is a STYLE/PALETTE reference only: do not copy its headline, scenery, mascot, CTA, or generic header lettering.
Create ONE coherent direction per image. Dominant large horizontal lockup in the upper/middle area, symbol at left and exact uppercase wordmark 'CELAHAN' at right when that direction includes a symbol. Beneath, two comfortably separated small monochrome studies: ink artwork on a plain ivory rectangle and ivory artwork on ink. These are specimens of the SAME concept, not extra logo directions. Balanced generous clear space, straightforward front-on 2D graphic presentation. No photographic mockups, perspective, embossed metal, glow, gradients, shadows, textures, 3D, tiny decorative annotation, slogan, trademark/registration sign, fake certification seal, padlock, shield, hooded hacker, bug, skull, crosshair, circuit-board clipart, or copied recognizable brand. Only the name CELAHAN may appear as text. Do not add badges or branding explanations. The logo must remain structurally meaningful in a single flat color, with robust open negative spaces and no fragile hairlines. Output one horizontal landscape concept sheet.

frames.title: Open Threshold
frames.brief: Create a distinctive architectural symbol based on a dark doorway/threshold, abstracted into a compact flat mark: a sand arch-shaped outer mass with an offset tall narrow open negative-space passage cut from top/inside toward the lower edge, and a single short offset base/threshold element. Use large clean planar shapes with one deliberate gap; no perspective, door handle, physical scene, bricks, light beam or stairs illustration. The shape should feel like a defined scope and a way through it, not a shield, rounded app icon, location pin, ordinary letter C, or crypto token. Pair with a refined uppercase sans CELAHAN wordmark with generous breathing room. Main sand symbol and ivory wordmark. Lower monochrome specimens preserve the exact arch/aperture geometry. This must be structurally different from an angular C monogram.
